Name: Hungry Horse
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=5] Hungry Horse - A Horse Stamina and Friendship System[/size]
[size=4] Overview
[/size][b]Hungry Horse[/b] enhances the realism of horseback riding in Stardew Valley by introducing [b]stamina and friendship mechanics[/b] for your horse. No longer just a simple mount, your horse now has a [b]limited stamina bar[/b] that depletes when running and recovers over time or through feeding. A [b]friendship system[/b] has also been added, allowing you to bond with your horse through petting and feeding.
[line][size=4] Features
[/size][size=3] Horse Stamina System[/size][list]
[*][b]Press the Left Shift key to make the horse run.[/b]
[*]Stamina decreases [b]when running[/b] with the horse.
[*][b]Walking[/b] does [b]not[/b] consume stamina.
[*]The horse [b]slowly recovers stamina[/b] when left in the farm.
[*][b]Stamina is fully restored[/b] every morning.
[*]If stamina reaches zero, the horse will [b]stop running[/b] and return home.
[/list][size=3] Horse Feeding System[/size][list]
[*]You can [b]feed the horse[/b] to restore stamina.
[*]Available food items: [b]Carrots, Summer Squash, Broccoli, and Powdermelon[/b].
[*][b]Feeding also increases friendship[/b] with the horse.
[*]If stamina is [b]already full[/b], the horse will refuse to eat.
[/list][size=3] Horse Friendship System[/size][list]
[*]The [b]friendship level[/b] affects stamina consumption.
[*][b]Higher friendship = slower stamina drain[/b].
[*]Increase friendship by:[list]
[*][b]Petting your horse once per day[/b]: +20 friendship.
[*][b]Feeding your horse[/b]: +10 friendship.
[/list]
[*][b]If the horse is left outside the farm overnight, friendship decreases (-50).[/b]
[/list][size=3] Speed Buff & Debuff[/size][list]
[*][b]Press Left Shift to run[/b], consuming stamina.
[*]If stamina is sufficient, the horse gains a [b]speed boost[/b].
[*]If stamina is low, the horse [b]moves slower[/b] or [b]refuses to run[/b].
[/list][line][size=4] Configuration
[/size]This mod supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], allowing you to customize:
[list]
[*][b]Enable/Disable the mod[/b]
[*][b]Max Stamina[/b]
[*][b]Stamina Decrease Rate[/b]
[*][b]Friendship Gain per Day[/b]
[*][b]Friendship Gain from Feeding[/b]
[/list]Without GMCM, these settings can be modified in the [code]config.json[/code] file.
[line][size=4] Installation[/size][list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b].
[*]Download [b]Hungry Horse[/b].
[*]Extract the [code]HungryHorse[/code] folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*]Run the game, and enjoy your new [b]horse mechanics![/b] 🐎
[/list][line][size=4] Compatibility
[/size]Compatible with [b]SMAPI 3.18+[/b]
Works with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
Not compatible with other [b]horse stamina mods[/b]
[line][size=4] Changelog[b]v0.0.3[/b] (Initial Release)[/size][list]
[*]Added [b]stamina system[/b] for horses.
[*]Introduced [b]horse feeding and friendship mechanics[/b].
[*]Implemented [b]speed buffs and debuffs[/b] based on stamina.
[*][b]Running now requires holding the Left Shift key.[/b]
[/list][line][size=4] Notes[/size][list]
[*][b]Press Left Shift to make the horse run.[/b]
[*][b]Leaving your horse outside the farm when sleeping will decrease friendship.[/b]
[*][b]Higher friendship reduces stamina consumption while running.[/b]
[*][b]You cannot feed the horse if stamina is full.[/b]
[/list][line][size=4] Author[/size][list]
[*][b]slO[/b]
[*]UniqueID: [code]slO.HungryHorse[/code]
[/list][line]Enjoy your new horse mechanics and happy farming! 🐎✨
